notes: Grid is explicit in the brief: 13x11. My job here is texture and route length, not difficulty — that lever belongs to the Pressure Designer.

items.rationale: Grid is fixed by the brief at 13x11, the shape reference/difficulty.md calls 'large' and gives room to breathe: the measured table puts 13x11 near 2.9-3.1 avg rounds regardless of pressure, so this size buys the extra round or two a hard dive should run without anyone touching oppRam or headStart. slag stays at the shipped default 0.18 — the table's calibration note is explicit that slag is texture, not difficulty, so I'm not pushing it toward the 0.22 corridor-heavy end for a harder read; a hard dive should read like a normal board played by a sharper opponent, not a maze. minCost 26 follows the 'roughly 2x width' guidance (2x13) and is exactly the value the schema's own 13x11 example uses, so it's within the generator's reach. minPd 8 protects the opening at about 1.5x the assumed playerRam of 5 (1.5x5=7.5, rounded up), so no lucky rotation closes the core in a single turn before the race even starts. Handing the Pressure Designer a 13x11/26/8 board: per the named-difficulty table, hard (28-40%) is reached on this grid with oppRam 6-7 and headStart 2, e.g. the measured 13x11/oppRam7/headStart2 row at 32.0% win, 2.3 avg rounds.
